    CLAUDE.md

    Guidance for working in GAMLj3 — a jamovi module (R package GAMLj3) providing a suite of linear models.

    What this is

    Four model families, each estimated by a different engine, but sharing one machine pipeline:

    Family Public fn (.f.R) jamovi name Engine(s)
    General gamlj_lm gamljlm stats::lm
    Mixed gamlj_mixed gamljmixed lmerTest::lmer, nlme::lme
    Generalized gamlj_glm gamljglm glm, clm, multinom, betareg
    Gen. Mixed gamlj_gmixed gamljgmixed glmer, clmm, mblogit

    File conventions (per family XXX)

    Two yaml layers — edit the source layer, not the generated one:

    • SOURCE (edit these): jamovi/scaffold/gamljXXX.{a,r,u}.preprocess.yaml. Plus shared fragments used across families: commons.{a,u}.yaml (common options/UI), plots.{a,u}.yaml (plot options/UI), clear.yaml (named clearWith option groups), clear_z.yaml/zclear.yaml, gamljmixed.options.yaml.
    • GENERATED (do not hand-edit): jamovi/gamljXXX.{a,r,u}.yaml — produced by jmvScaffold’s preprocessor from the scaffold/ sources. .a=options, .r=results (tables/plots/groups; each table lists clearWith: options that invalidate it), .u=UI.
    • R/gamljXXX.h.R — AUTO-GENERATED from the generated yaml. Never hand-edit. Defines gamljXXXBase, gamljXXXOptions, gamljXXXResults.
    • R/gamljXXX.b.R — backend R6 class gamljXXXClass (inherits gamljXXXBase). .init() registers result tables; .run() estimates + fills. Keep it thin.
    • R/gamljXXX.f.R — exported public API function with roxygen docs.
    • build/js/gamljXXX.src.js + gamlj.events.js — hand-written jamovi UI event handlers.

    Scaffold preprocess directives

    In the scaffold/*.preprocess.yaml files, a block like:

    clearWith:
    -   type: scaffold
        name: opts_model
        file: clear.yaml

    is an include: the preprocessor expands the named block (opts_model, defined in clear.yaml as a children: list of option names) inline. This keeps clearWith lists and shared option/UI sets DRY across the four families. commons.* / plots.* fragments are pulled into each family the same way.

    The machine pipeline (shared logic — edit here, not in .b.R)

    Inheritance chain (R6):

    Scaffold (R/jScaffolding.R)      option()/optionValue(); self$warning<- / self$error<- ; self$stop()
  └─ Initier (R/Initier.R)       builds formulaobj (gFormula) + infomatic; all init_<table>() skeletons
       └─ Runner (R/Runner.R)    estimate(data) builds & evals model call; all run_<table>() fillers

    Instantiated in .b.R$.init(): - Datamatic (R/Datamatic.R) + inner Variable — validate vars, build contrast codes, scale/center covariates, cleandata(). - Infomatic (R/Infomatic.R) — per-model_type spec: rcall, family, link, deptype, r2, info-table text. Add a new model type here. - Dispatch (R/Dispatch.R) — routes warnings/errors to tables by _-joined topic path.

    Cross-cutting: R/Formula.R (gFormula), R/procedures.R (emmeans/posthoc/simple effects), R/effectsize.R + R/parameters.R + R/anovas.R + R/gfit.R (stat tables), R/Plotter.R (ggplot), R/model.functions.R (mf.* S3 generics over model classes), R/update.R (.update.*), R/constants.R (WARNS, greek, B64 symbols), R/functions.R (tob64/fromb64, jinfo, try_hard).

    The scaffold framework R6 classes (R/jScaffolding.R, R/SmartTabs.R, R/Dispatch.R, R/jScafFunctions.R — Scaffold/SmartTable/SmartArray/Dispatch) originate from the jmvScaffold package (https://github.com/mcfanda/jmvScaffold). They are tracked in R/ here; treat them as framework code, not GAMLj-specific logic.

    SmartTabs — the table contract

    SmartTable/SmartArray (R/SmartTabs.R) wrap each jamovi result element. A table at result path main/coefficients → nickname main_coefficients → engine auto-calls init_main_coefficients() (skeleton, in Initier) at init and run_main_coefficients() (data, in Runner) at run.

    To add a result table: 1. Declare it in jamovi/scaffold/gamljXXX.r.preprocess.yaml (with clearWith:), then rebuild (preprocess + regenerate header — see below). 2. In .b.R$.init(): aSmartObj <- SmartTable$new(self$results$main$mytable, runner_machine) and ladd(private$.smartObjs) <- aSmartObj. 3. Add init_main_mytable() to Initier and run_main_mytable() to Runner (or the family .b.R if family-specific).

    Naming: base64

    Variable names are base64-encoded internally (tob64/fromb64 in R/functions.R) so they survive formula parsing — encoded names appear throughout the data, formulas, and table source columns. Use fromb64() before displaying.

    Dev workflow

    Always run build commands from the repo root (the dir containing the jamovi/ folder). The author’s own jmvScaffold package drives jamovi builds (not plain jmvtools).

    1. Compile/install the R package

    devtools::install()      # from repo root; or: R CMD INSTALL .
devtools::document()     # after editing .f.R roxygen (regenerates man/ + NAMESPACE)

    This must be done before a jamovi build: the build commands call library(GAMLj3) and read the installed package version.

    2. Build the jamovi module — two commands

    # (a) R code changed, NO yaml change — faster:
jmvScaffold::install_module("GAMLj3", ref="gamlj")

# (b) yaml changed (anything under jamovi/scaffold/) — full rebuild:
jmvScaffold::install_module_full("GAMLj3")
    • install_module() = versionize() (bumps jamovi/00refs.yaml) + processReadme() (writes version into README) + jmvtools::install(home="flatpak"). It does not preprocess yaml.
    • install_module_full() = preprocess_yaml() (jamovi/scaffold/*.preprocess.yaml → generated jamovi/*.yaml, expanding type: scaffold includes) → jmvtools::install() (generates R/*.h.R, builds) → postprocess_yaml() → jmvtools::install() again.
    • Both install into the jamovi flatpak (home="flatpak").

    Version gate (important)

    Both build commands silently no-op with "versions mismatch" unless three versions match: git branch name (Version.3.6.6 → 3.6.6) == installed pkg version (DESCRIPTION) == jamovi/0000.yaml version:. When releasing, bump all three together (and re-devtools::install() so the installed version updates).

    Tests & branches

    • Tests: devtools::test() (or testthat::test_local()). Tests in tests/testthat/test_*.R call the public API and assert on $main$coefficients$asDF etc.
    • Main / PR branch: master.

    Typical feature loop

    edit jamovi/scaffold/*.preprocess.yaml → implement init_*/run_* + register SmartTable in .b.R → devtools::install() → jmvScaffold::install_module_full("GAMLj3") → add a test → devtools::test(). (If you touched only R code, use install_module("GAMLj3", ref="gamlj") instead of the full rebuild.)
